# Retained DynaComp modules for source observation audits

bounds.py, rational.py and finite.py are unchanged copies from the user-owned DynaComp0.12.0 archive. Source and archive SHA256 hashes are in ../../receipts/stress/broader_provenance.json. An isolated namespace stub was added. No license file was present in that archive; no unrelated license was assigned.

The NFL adapter uses exact rational linear envelopes on declared scenario boxes, finite-machine quotient/replay and rational design rank/nullspace. These calculations certify their stated finite/algebraic models, not athlete physiology, sensor calibration or NFL predictive accuracy. Other DynaComp runtime, importer and reduction modules are not represented as imported here.
